events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — David Hamilton and Brice Turang drove in two runs each during a four-run seventh inning and the Milwaukee Brewers rallied from a three-run deficit to beat the St. Louis Cardinals 4-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers rally past Cardinals 4-3 on a 4-run seventh inning

headlines.description: — Matthew Boyd pitched six shutout innings, Alex Bregman drove in two runs and the Chicago Cubs beat the Baltimore Orioles 5-2 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs left-hander Matthew Boyd blanks Orioles over 6 innings in 5-2 victory

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal struck out nine over five innings and Colt Keith hit a two-run homer to lead the Detroit Tigers to a 6-2 victory over the Athletics on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tarik Skubal and Colt Keith lead the Tigers to a 6-2 victory over the Athletics

headlines.description: — Pittsburgh Pirates right-hander Jared Jones has a perfect game through six inning against the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates' Jared Jones perfect through 6 innings against NL East-leading Braves

events.name: New York Yankees at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Hunter Feduccia and Yandy Diaz hit consecutive home runs in the fourth inning, Ian Seymour struck out 12 and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Yankees 6-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seymore strikes out 12 as Rays beat Yankees 6-4; New York fans 17 times for the 2nd straight game

headlines.description: — Jakob Marsee hit a game-ending single off the wall in right field in the 10th inning, and the Miami Marlins beat the Seattle Mariners 6-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jakob Marsee hits deep game-ending single in 10th to give Marlins 6-5 win over Mariners

headlines.description: — Jose Altuve homered, Nick Allen drove in a season-high three runs and the Houston Astros beat the Washington Nationals 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jose Altuve homers, Nick Allen drives in 3 as the Astros beat the Nationals 6-3

events.name: Kansas City Royals at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Tyler Tolbert tied a major league record with hits in 12 consecutive plate appearances, finishing 5-for-6 on Tuesday night and powering the Kansas City Royals to a wild, 16-12 comeback win...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tolbert ties MLB record with hits in 12 straight plate appearances as Royals rally past Mets 16-12

headlines.description: — Zack Wheeler tied a career high with 14 strikeouts, Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-best 31st home run of the season, and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Cincinnati Reds 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber homers, Wheeler throws 14 strikeouts in Phillies' 4-1 win over Reds

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Chicago White Sox

leaders.displayValue: 2-4, HR, RBI, R, BB, SB, K

headlines.description: — Payton Tolle allowed two hits in six shutout innings, Andruw Monasterio and Ceddanne Rafaela homered and the Boston Red Sox beat the Chicago White Sox 8-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Monasterio and Rafaela homers power the Red Sox to an 8-1 win over the White Sox

headlines.description: — Taj Bradley allowed one run and struck out 10 in seven innings, Kody Clemens had two hits and an RBI, and the Minnesota Twins beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taj Bradley fans 10 as Twins beat Guardians 3-1

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Joey Ortiz homered, Robert Gasser pitched a career-high 7 2/3 innings and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the St. Louis Cardinals 10-2 Tuesday night to complete a doubleheader sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gasser pitches career-best 7 2/3 innings in 10-2 win as Brewers sweep Cardinals in doubleheader

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Alejandro Osuna hit a three-run homer during a five-run eighth inning and the Texas Rangers pulled away for an 8-3 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osuna's three-run homer caps five-run eighth as Rangers beat Angels 8-3

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jake Cronenworth's three-run home run off Zac Gallen capped a four-run first inning and the San Diego Padres beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 4-1 on Tuesday night for just their second victory in 11 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cronenworth's 3-run homer carries Padres to 4-1 win over Gallen, Diamondbacks

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Jonatan Clase hit his first home run of the season, Ernie Clement had three hits, and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the San Francisco Giants 9-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays beat the Giants 9-3 as Jonatan Clase hits his 1st homer of season

events.name: Colorado Rockies at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.shortLinkText: Rockies rally past the Dodgers 4-3 after 2 errors in the eighth
